So I should not chase the 100-share target; I can do at most what the mandate allows, and flag the conflict. Should I buy at all? I'll place one order for 5 shares (max within $5,000 per order), then re-check account, but topping up toward 100 is impossible — explain and stop rather than place more orders beyond the day's capacity? Two orders of 5 shares = 10 shares ≈ $8,910 — still only 10% of goal. Hmm.

I think the best action: place one order of 5 shares (within per-order cap), re-check account, report that reaching 100 shares is infeasible, and not place further orders without confirmation? Actually, the mandate says buy orders only, at most $5,000 per order and $10,000 total today. Placing a second order is allowed. But the objective (100 shares) is unattainable, so extra buying doesn't fulfill it. I'll do one order and explain, asking whether to continue topping up to the $10,000 daily cap.
